title: Today's lessons
summary: Each day the app picks the five lessons that matter most and keeps them for the day.
description: The home screen answers one question: what should I do today. It gives a short list, chosen once and kept. Doing it is the day done, with a celebration and nothing more. For more, a course's page lists its lessons in the same order of importance.

requirements.text: The day's list is chosen once a day and kept for that day; it is chosen again only when the learner changes how many lessons a day they want, or when the kept list names no lesson this device has.
The list has 5 lessons unless the learner sets another number, from 1 to 20.
Lessons that failed or were partly there last time and are due again come first.
Other due lessons follow, those most at risk first: the furthest past their interval, with lessons of lower ease ahead.
While there is room, at most 2 new lessons a day are added, taken from the newest courses.
If a place is still free, at most 1 mastered lesson whose words are due for review is added as a light review.
A review of a mastered lesson never takes the place of a due or new lesson, and cannot cost the lesson its mastery.
A mastered lesson, or one listed only by a closed course, is never due.
A course's challenges are offered only once its other lessons are passed.
Finishing the list is the day done, shown with a celebration; lessons due beyond the list are not shown on the home screen.
The day's list is the same on every device in a vault; if two devices chose a list while apart, the later one wins.
